entries.title: Stardew Valley

emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Windows PC with current patch and optional mods

primary.why: Stardew Valley released first on Windows, then Linux, macOS, PlayStation 4, Xbox One, Nintendo Switch, PlayStation Vita, iOS, Android, Tesla Arcade, and Nintendo Switch 2. Windows is the best archive route because it has the highest capture/settings and mod ceiling, receives major updates first, and has a well-supported PC version.
primary.how_to_play: Use the current Windows version through Steam, GOG, or PC Game Pass. Confirm the latest patch and mod state before capture.

entries.remaster_caveats: Live patch cadence matters; verify the latest platform patch before capture.
